description: The capability contract src/services/vscodeLmCompat.ts's probeLmToolCallingHostCapabilityV1 checks before any model selection or file read in the implementation-edit runner, and the expected outcome per host tier. This is a static description of the probe's own logic (kept in sync manually with vscodeLmCompat.ts pending scripts/verifyVscodeLmApiBoundary.mjs growing an automated cross-check); it is not itself evidence that a real host of each version behaves this way — that requires the host-matrix tests plan §1.6 §1.7 describe, which this environment cannot run.

hostTiers.rationale: Declared engines.vscode floor; tool-calling constructors are not guaranteed present. probeLmToolCallingHostCapabilityV1 must return supported:false before vscode.lm.selectChatModels or any file read.
Plan §1.6/§7.5 floor for request-local preflight/edit actions.

currentEvidence.description: Proves the probe's own fail-closed logic (naming what's missing, never throwing, running before model selection) against test-stubs/vscode, which exposes every constructor. Does not prove real-host behavior at any of the three version tiers above.

notCoveredYet: No @vscode/test-electron acquisition/run exists for 1.93.0, 1.100.0, or 1.110.0 (plan §1.6 step 7, AC-HOST-02/03). This requires downloading and running real VS Code binaries on pinned Windows/Linux/macOS runners, which this sandbox cannot do.
